EnvironmentCreatedEvent.label: Environment Created
EnvironmentCreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a new environment is created.

EnvironmentDeletedEvent.label: Environment Deleted
EnvironmentDeletedEvent.description: Triggered when an environment is deleted.

EnvironmentUpdatedEvent.label: Environment Updated
EnvironmentUpdatedEvent.description: Triggered when an environment is updated.

EnvironmentVariablesUpdatedEvent.label: Environment Variables Updated
EnvironmentVariablesUpdatedEvent.description: Triggered when environment variables are updated.

ProjectCreatedEvent.label: Project Created
ProjectCreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a new project is created.

ProjectDeletedEvent.label: Project Deleted
ProjectDeletedEvent.description: Triggered when a project is deleted.

ProjectUpdatedEvent.label: Project Updated
ProjectUpdatedEvent.description: Triggered when a project is updated.

ServiceCrashedEvent.label: Service Crashed
ServiceCrashedEvent.description: Triggered when a service that should be running stops unexpectedly. Not triggered by an intentional stop.

ServiceRuntimeStateChangedEvent.label: Runtime State Changed
ServiceRuntimeStateChangedEvent.description: Triggered when the observed runtime state of a service or sidecar changes.

ServiceHealthChangedEvent.label: Health Changed
ServiceHealthChangedEvent.description: Triggered when the observed health of a running service or sidecar changes.

ServiceCreatedEvent.label: Service Created
ServiceCreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a new service is created.

ServiceDeletedEvent.label: Service Deleted
ServiceDeletedEvent.description: Triggered when a service is deleted.

ServiceDeployedEvent.label: Service Deployed
ServiceDeployedEvent.description: Triggered when a service is deployed.

ServiceRecoveredEvent.label: Service Recovered
ServiceRecoveredEvent.description: Triggered when a service becomes healthy again after being unhealthy.

ServiceRestartedEvent.label: Service Restarted
ServiceRestartedEvent.description: Triggered when a service is restarted.

ServiceStoppedEvent.label: Service Stopped
ServiceStoppedEvent.description: Triggered when a service is stopped.

ServiceDeployingEvent.label: Service Deploying
ServiceDeployingEvent.description: Triggered when a service is deploying.

ServiceUpdatedEvent.label: Service Updated
ServiceUpdatedEvent.description: Triggered when a service is updated.

SidecarCreatedEvent.label: Sidecar Created
SidecarCreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a new sidecar is created.

SidecarUpdatedEvent.label: Sidecar Updated
SidecarUpdatedEvent.description: Triggered when a sidecar is updated.

SidecarDeletedEvent.label: Sidecar Deleted
SidecarDeletedEvent.description: Triggered when a sidecar is deleted.

SidecarEnabledEvent.label: Sidecar Enabled
SidecarEnabledEvent.description: Triggered when a sidecar is enabled.

SidecarDisabledEvent.label: Sidecar Disabled
SidecarDisabledEvent.description: Triggered when a sidecar is disabled.

SidecarAttachedEvent.label: Sidecar Attached
SidecarAttachedEvent.description: Triggered when a sidecar is attached to a network.

SidecarDetachedEvent.label: Sidecar Detached
SidecarDetachedEvent.description: Triggered when a sidecar is detached from a network.

NetworkCreatedEvent.label: Network Created
NetworkCreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a new network is created.

NetworkDeletedEvent.label: Network Deleted
NetworkDeletedEvent.description: Triggered when a network is deleted.

NetworkRecreatedEvent.label: Network Recreated
NetworkRecreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a network is recreated, for example after its subnet changes.

User.UserCreatedEvent.label: User Created
User.UserCreatedEvent.description: Triggered when a new user is created.
